metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.query:
let parser = (disabled:bool=false) {
    HalcyonEventsV2_CL
    | where not(disabled)
        and class_uid == 3002                                    // OCSF Authentication
    | extend
        EventType      = "Logon",                                // activity_id 1 (Logon); brute force = logon attempts
        SrcIpAddr      = tostring(src_endpoint.ip),              // parsed from the source log; empty when no parseable value is present
        TargetUsername = tostring(user.name),                   // attacked account; empty when no regex match
        TargetUserId   = tostring(user.uid),                    // always empty in the source data
        TargetDvcId    = tostring(dst_endpoint.uid),            // logon target asset
        DvcHostname_raw = tostring(dst_endpoint.hostname),
        _filter_name   = tostring(unmapped.halcyon_filter_name),
        EventOriginalSeverity = tostring(severity)
    | invoke _ASIM_ResolveDvcFQDN('DvcHostname_raw')
    | extend
        TargetHostname = DvcHostname,
        // These events are always failed logons (OCSF status_id 2). action_id reflects whether the
        // security control intervened (Block/Report), not logon success.
        EventResult = "Failure",
        EventResultDetails = case(_filter_name in~ ("IncorrectPasswordAttempts", "FailedPassword"), "Incorrect password", "Other"),
        DvcAction   = case(action_id == 2, "Deny", action_id == 1, "Allow", ""),
        EventSeverity = case(
                            EventOriginalSeverity in~ ("Informational", "Info"), "Informational",
                            EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Low", "Low",
                            EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Medium", "Medium",
                            EventOriginalSeverity in~ ("High", "Critical", "Fatal"), "High",
                            EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Unknown", "Informational",
                            "Informational"),
        TargetUsernameType = _ASIM_GetUsernameType(tostring(user.name)),
        TargetUserIdType   = "",                                 // user.uid always empty -> no id type
        TargetDvcIdType    = iff(isnotempty(tostring(dst_endpoint.uid)), "Other", ""),
        DvcIdType          = iff(isnotempty(tostring(dst_endpoint.uid)), "Other", ""),
        EventStartTime = coalesce(HalcyonSourceTime, TimeGenerated)
    | extend
        Dvc          = coalesce(TargetDvcId, DvcHostname),
        EventEndTime = EventStartTime,
        User         = TargetUsername,
        IpAddr       = SrcIpAddr,                                // required ASIM alias of SrcIpAddr
        Src          = SrcIpAddr,                                // recommended; source identifier (attacker IP, may be empty on regex no-match)
        Dst          = TargetHostname,                           // recommended; logon-target host
        EventCount   = int(1),
        EventUid     = HalcyonEventId,
        EventOriginalUid = HalcyonEventId,
        EventMessage = tostring(message),
        EventOriginalType = tostring(type_name),
        EventOriginalSubType = tostring(activity_name),
        EventProduct = "Halcyon",
        EventVendor  = "Halcyon",
        EventSchema  = "Authentication",
        EventSchemaVersion = "0.1.4",
        AdditionalFields = bag_pack(
                              "halcyon_alert_id",    tostring(unmapped.halcyon_alert_id),
                              "halcyon_tenant_id",   tostring(unmapped.halcyon_tenant_id),
                              "halcyon_event_kind",  tostring(unmapped.halcyon_event_kind),
                              "halcyon_filter_name", _filter_name,
                              "halcyon_raw_log",     tostring(raw_data)
                          )
    | project-away DvcHostname_raw, _filter_name
};
parser(disabled=disabled)
